bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches are allowed. Small non-clear or clear clutch bags up to 6 x 9 inches are also allowed, along with empty hydration packs within the festival compartment rules.
allowed: clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
small clutch bags up to 6 x 9 inches
bagPolicy.note: All guests agree to thorough security screening. Review the current festival guide before arrival.

parking.note: Use the festival's current Parking & Drop-Offs page for official parking directions and restrictions. Vehicles must leave the parking lot after each festival day.

rideshare.note: Rideshare, taxi, and guest drop-offs use the designated Guest Drop-Off and Pickup location. The current guide directs rideshare drivers toward the Big Lots parking lot off Orange Show Road and Arrowhead Boulevard.

concessions.note: Food, drinks, and other festival amenities are available on site. Exact vendors and locations vary by edition; use the current festival map and Amenities & Services guide.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The festival provides accessible routes connecting parking, entrances, stages, viewing areas, vendors, and other activity areas. Limited accessible parking is available first come, first served.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed; the festival does not permit ins-and-outs.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Box Office/Will Call hours are published in the current Hours & Info guide for each edition. Confirm the posted hours before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entry is through the festival entrances shown in the current map and event guide. Expect TSA-style security screening and confirm event hours in the current Hours & Info page.
